title: Python Runtime — Overview and definition
description: Executes Python programs with the standard library, packaging, and C-extension support.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Executes Python programs with the standard library, packaging, and C-extension support. A Python runtime interprets and JIT-assists Python bytecode, ships the standard library, and loads C extensions for numeric and system work. Real implementations include CPython (the reference), PyPy (tracing JIT), and MicroPython/CircuitPython for microcontrollers. It manages packaging via pip, virtual environments, and wheels, and exposes embedding APIs for host applications.
capabilities: Execute Python 3 source and bytecode with full standard library
Install and isolate packages with pip and virtual environments
Accelerate numeric code via C extensions (NumPy) and JIT (PyPy/Numba)
Embed in C/C++ hosts and extend with native modules
Run on microcontrollers via MicroPython/CircuitPython builds
